subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of the Railways (Amendment) Bill, 2024?

options.text: To introduce high-speed bullet trains across India
To establish a new ministry for railway operations
To merge the Indian Railway Board Act, 1905 into the Railways Act, 1989

solution:
The Correct answer is __**To merge the Indian Railway Board Act, 1905 into the Railways Act, 1989**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Railways (Amendment) Bill, 2024** aims to streamline the legal framework governing the Indian Railways by merging the **Indian Railway Board Act, 1905** into the **Railways Act, 1989**.
 
• This amendment seeks to eliminate redundancy and modernize the administration of railways in India.
